evidence.explanation: C finish_map is delegated to JS mkmap_finish_map. Executed public mines initialization preserves the tested lighting and ice-tag effects; the differing callee name does not establish missing behavior. This is a finite non-walled/no-room metadata proof, not full cave or finish_map equivalence.
evidence.proof: Twelve targets: foreground/background ICE/LAVA, ROOM/TREE, TREE/ROOM × lit0/1 × icedpools flag absent/present, seed24301. Eight controls: ROOM/STONE and ICE/STONE × the same switches. All1659cells per map match exact compiled C finish_map on the observed terrain, starting with zero metadata/no rooms. Lava lights with lit0; background trees light with lit1 but foreground trees stay dark; ice tags switch16→8 via the public level_flags API.
evidence.control: ROOM/STONE controls discriminate lit0/1 without lava/ice/tree exceptions; ICE/STONE controls isolate the pool/moat tag switch. The C oracle consumes only observed JS terrain, never JS metadata; terrain/RNG generation itself is not compared. No walls, room lighting, joining, smoothing, reused-state metadata, finalization or runtime claims.
